newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian scientist shoots five, then himself.
newsitem.headline: Russian scientist shoots five, then himself.

text.p: An elderly computer scientist shot dead his wife and four colleagues before taking his own life in the central city of Kazan on Tuesday, Russian news agencies said.
Karen Zhamogortyan, the 65-year-old director of a computer science institute affiliated to the Russian Academy of Sciences, killed his colleagues with a makeshift pistol.
He then drove home, picked up his wife Larisa and shot her in his car outside a hospital before turning the gun on himself.
Police are investigating the killings, whose motive remains unclear, the agencies said.
Russian science has been racked with financial troubles since the collapse of the Soviet Union.

One leading academician went on hunger strike recently to publicise the cause. The head of a major nuclear research centre shot himself in his office last month, apparently weary of the battle for funds to keep the facility open.
